claim.statement: Anysphere's June 2026 Auto-review description says the feature is focused on local agents in the desktop app, is the default for new users and can be enabled by existing users; its classifier can inspect workspace context before deciding how a tool call proceeds.

source.title: Governing agent autonomy with Auto-review
source.locator: Building the classifier and Refining agent autonomy

limitations: The page is a publisher research description and does not bind the default to every 3.14 account, upgrade path or organization policy.
Reported internal classifier evaluation and aggregate interruption rates are not included as independent findings.
unknowns: Whether a particular 3.14 user was new or existing and which run mode was effective are unknown.
The classifier model, policy revision, context, allowlist and decision for any action are unknown.

relationships.note: The rolling June description adds current audience and default statements to the 3.6 introduction milestone; the catalog preserves their different time applicability.
